title: Software Tester
description:
Experience: 6+ Years
Work mode: Full-Time | Onsite

 About the Role:- 
We are seeking a skilled QA Engineer with strong experience in both Manual and Automation Testing (Selenium) to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and maintaining comprehensive test plans to ensure the delivery of high-quality software products. You will collaborate closely with development and product teams to identify issues early, automate testing processes, and uphold software reliability across web and enterprise applications.

 Key Responsibilities:- 
 Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for web and enterprise applications.
Conduct functional, regression, integration, and API testing to ensure complete product validation.
Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Java and Selenium.
Identify, document, and track software defects using standard bug tracking and test management tools.
Collaborate with developers and business analysts to understand requirements and provide feedback on testability.
Participate actively in Agile development cycles, ensuring quality throughout SDLC and STLC phases.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for testing processes and automation coverage.

 Required Skills & Experience:- 
 6 years of experience in Software Testing (Manual & Automation).
Hands-on expertise in Selenium WebDriver with Java-based automation frameworks (TestNG, JUnit).
Strong knowledge of Functional, Regression, Integration, and API Testing.
Experience with tools such as Postman, JIRA, TestRail, or similar platforms.
Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

 Good to Have:- 
 Experience in CI/CD integration (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
 Exposure to cloud testing environments (AWS, Azure).
Basic knowledge of performance or security testing tools.

Key Skills: Software Testing,Java,BDD Framework,API Testing,Playwright,Database Testing,Automation Testing,Manual Testing
